name: data-intensive-apps
description: Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for data ownership, consistency, retries and replay, schema evolution, replication, partitioning and streams.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Designing Data-Intensive Applications rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
